scope: SC2 stock package metadata projection through public ContentSources and one mod loader

tests.suite: workspace, JsonMod, SC2 codecs and source projection
CASC source regression after metadata revision change
public Host against installed SC2, Void and VoidStory
local and CASC source node tests

observations: Missing stock DocumentInfo is exposed by folder, MPQ and CASC content sources; no disk metadata is written.
Real metadata wins. An existing empty dependency list is not replaced with a basename dependency chain.
Void resolves Core, Liberty and Swarm as declared metadata dependencies; Marine LifeMax resolves to 45.
VoidStory resolves its matching data mod with no unresolved dependencies.
Virtual metadata is visible in list, files and read, including in ModContext.locate.
CASC source revision includes the virtual metadata digest to invalidate persisted source indexes.
coverageLimits: This receipt does not claim complete SC2 MK2 feature parity or release acceptance.
Public online Battle.net authorization, publishing and deletion are not exercised.
